title: Release Contextualizer and Profile Inspector: inline version chooser with performance annotations
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build an inline ‘Release Contextualizer’ panel and a lightweight Performance Profile Inspector that surfaces per-version latency/cost/quality annotations directly where customers choose a model version. Goal: reduce context switches between the model selector, perf dashboards, and rollout flows so platform users can make informed pinning decisions faster and with fewer mistakes.
background: PM and support conversations show repeated friction: engineers open the model selector to pin a version but then must switch to the perf dashboard to compare latency/throughput/cost profiles. This results in longer decision time, accidental pins, and support tickets about unexpected latency changes post-pin. Existing console screens are modular but disconnected (selector, profile viewer, rollout composer). We want a contextual surface that combines selection and key performance indicators plus provenance of published profiles.
proposal: Add a compact right-side 'Contextualizer' drawer attached to the version selection modal and the rollout composer. The drawer will show: 1) Top-line KPIs for the selected version (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, sample quality score), 2) Recent regression alerts and eval snapshot links, 3) Quick actions: 'Pin here', 'Start canary', 'Open full profile', and 'Compare to current pinned'. Implement the Performance Profile Inspector as a lightweight overlay that shows trace thumbnails, workload histograms, and the publish timestamp + author. Profiles will link back to the model catalog and to the underlying perf snapshot in Optimize. When a user hovers versions, show live deltas versus the currently pinned version (latency delta, cost delta, quality delta). Provide affordances for sticky notes explaining anomalies (e.g., short burst affecting p95).
ui_flow: 1) User clicks version dropdown on a route, 2) Contextualizer drawer opens showing metrics for hovered/selected version, 3) User can toggle a 'Show deltas' switch to compare against the live pinned version, 4) User clicks 'Pin version' which opens a small confirmation with rollout options (immediate, canary %, staged), 5) On pinning, an inline toast displays the published profile link and an auto-generated runbook suggestion. If profile publishing is stale, show a red badge with a 'Publish profile' CTA.
acceptance_criteria: Contextualizer opens from version dropdown and displays per-version KPIs within 300ms for cached profiles
Hovering a version shows delta metrics vs pinned version and highlights positive/negative deltas
Pin action initiates the existing pin API and the confirmation UI supports immediate and canary options
If a version has no published profile, the drawer surfaces 'Profile not published' and a one-click link to publish flow
Published profile links navigate to the Optimize snapshot and include author + timestamp metadata
GA event instrumentation exists for: contextualizer_open, version_hover, pin_attempt, pin_confirm, publish_profile_click
